artboards.title: Panel · entry point and new-role accent

annotations.text:
Entry point: the box glyph beside the tenant pills and an "Access packages…" menu item. Both appear only when the tenant token carries the entitlement scope.

New-role accent: tinted row plus a "new" badge (not colour alone). Clears the second time the panel opens after the roles were first shown.

Window: 560×520, same shell as Configure known PIM roles. Segmented tabs, search filters the current tab by package name and description. Footer: refresh, last-updated, Close (Esc).

Available rows show a caption instead of Request when a pending request or delivered assignment already exists.

Request sheet: attached to the window (HIG sheet). Policy picker only when more than one policy applies. Justification required. Submit is the default button on the right; Cancel to its left.

When the chosen policy requires question answers, the sheet explains and hands off to My Access instead of showing a form.

State dots reuse the panel's colours: yellow pending, green delivered or delivering, orange expiring within 7 days, red denied or failed, grey canceled. The requester's own justification is always shown; approver justification is not readable with the self-service permission, so it is not shown.
